- $44 \times 4{,}193{,}821 = 184{,}528{,}124$, so the factorization $45^5 - 1 = 44 \cdot s$ with $s = 4{,}193{,}821$ is right.
- $1471 \times 2851 = 4{,}193{,}821$. Multiplying out: $1471 \times 2851 = 4{,}118{,}800 + 75{,}021 = 4{,}193{,}821$.
- Both factors are prime. For 1471 (√ ≈ 38.4), no prime up to 37 divides it. For 2851 (√ ≈ 53.4), no prime up to 53 divides it.
- So $45^5 - 1 = 2^2 \cdot 11 \cdot 1471 \cdot 2851$, and the largest prime factor is 2851.
- As a consistency check, any prime divisor of $s$ must satisfy $p \equiv 1 \pmod 5$, and both 1471 and 2851 do.
